profile.headline: Software Engineer, Game Developer

positions.title: Co-founder, Lead Programmer
positions.description:
- Led development on an indie PC title, Roguelite turn-based deckbuilder with cozy hand-drawn 2D graphics.
- Created 2D asset pipeline and customizable gameplay systems for lead artist and game designer.
- https://store.steampowered.com/app/2379370/COLORS_of_NOBILITY/

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Shipped multiple games on ZEPETO, a global live service metaverse platform of 25M+ MAU
- Rapid iterations on novel gameplay prototypes as part of R&D team, also optimizing/polishing with 3D artists
- Unity C#, Mobile platform (iOS, Android)
positions.insights: Skills: Game Development · Unity · C# · TypeScript

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built core features for a 3D real-time video chat platform in an early Agile startup.
- Key contributions: Multiplayer lobby, screenshare, live drawing, and text chat.
- Core tech: Unity3D, C#, Photon Network, DarkRift2, Agora Video, Wwise.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Enhanced features for DomiNations, a F2P mobile game with 50M+ downloads.
- Refactored and optimized a large-scale C# codebase in Unity3D.
- Core tech: Unity3D, C#, Mobile in-app purchases, UI/UX, client-server integration.

positions.title: Student Research Software Developer
positions.description:
- Created a full-stack mobile research platform for patient remote activity monitoring
- Developed iOS/Android mobile apps for user-facing health data visualization and feedback
- Automated Fitbit API patient data collection into in-house MariaDB server on Ubuntu
- Tech stack: Heroku, MariaDB, Django, React Native, Android Studio

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Contributed on the exchange's REST API source code, built on Scala Play Framework
- Created a standardized API integration/scenario testing suite, using JUnit
- Managed user-facing API documentation website, using Slate with Ruby on Rails

positions.title: Korean Army Sergeant, Senior KATUSA Squad Leader
positions.description:
- Served as Korean Augmentation to the US Army (KATUSA) as part of mandatory Korean military service
- Battalion level English-Korean interpreter and liaison in US-Korea Joint Task Force exercises
- Exemplary Soldier of the Year Award (2014)

allTitles: Korean Army Sergeant, Senior KATUSA Squad Leader
